plurals.name: instructions
plurals.item: Make %1$d full wrist twist (%2$d alternating pulses): out and back. Keep the strap snug. Continuous sensing uses extra battery.
Make %1$d full wrist twists (%2$d alternating pulses): out and back each time. Keep the strap snug. Continuous sensing uses extra battery.

resources.string: No system speech recognizer is installed. Enable voice input in watch settings, then try again.
The watch refused speech recognition. Check system voice input permissions.
